cases.question: 按商品英文品类统计有效订单GMV
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT 
  dc.category_name_en AS 英文品类,
  SUM(foi.price) AS 成交总额
FROM fact_order_item foi
INNER JOIN fact_order fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON foi.product_id = dp.product_id
INNER JOIN dim_category dc ON dp.category_id = dc.category_id
WHERE fo.status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY dc.category_id, dc.category_name_en
ORDER BY dc.category_id ASC;
cases.validated_sql: SELECT dc.category_name_en AS 英文品类, SUM(foi.price) AS 成交总额 FROM fact_order_item AS foi INNER JOIN fact_order AS fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id INNER JOIN dim_product AS dp ON foi.product_id = dp.product_id INNER JOIN dim_category AS dc ON dp.category_id = dc.category_id WHERE NOT fo.status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY dc.category_id, dc.category_name_en ORDER BY dc.category_id ASC LIMIT 500
